experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Small dataset, resampling only, trivially cheap.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether the bootstrap confidence interval for a median achieves nominal coverage on skewed data.
experiment_plans.design: Simulation study: repeated sampling from known distributions, bootstrap interval per sample.

data_requirements.description: Samples drawn from distributions of varying skewness with known medians.
preprocessing_steps: Draw samples at each skewness level with a fixed seed

methods.name: percentile bootstrap
methods.description: Resample with replacement and take percentiles of the bootstrap distribution.

evaluation.baseline: The nominal 95% coverage the interval claims.
evaluation.success_criteria: Empirical coverage stays within 0.03 of nominal at every skewness level.

implementation_steps.description: Measure empirical coverage against the known median

risks: Coverage estimates are themselves noisy with few replicates.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
